name: Aingura Tattoo Studio
bio:
Immerse yourself in the monochromatic mastery at Mikel Uria Tattoo Studio, nestled in the vibrant heart of Pasajes, Spain, on Avenida Euskadi n°15 Entresuelo Trintxerpe, Gipuzkoa. A haven for black & gray ink aficionados, this studio promises a serene environment where the artistry of Mikel Uria transforms skin into a canvas of intricate shades and stunning detail. Contact at 943543814 or ainguratattoo@gmail.com to etch your vision into a timeless piece.
